description: Retaintive shared Renovate defaults. Repos use it with "extends": ["local>retaintive/.github:renovate-config"] and keep only repo-specific rules.
One weekly batch PR for all minor/patch updates, automerged once every required check is green; majors stay separate and manual; lock files are refreshed weekly; security fixes open immediately.
Automerge relies on the repository having required status checks (rulesets). Do not extend this preset from a repo without them.

packageRules.description: Weekly non-major batch (group:allNonMajor) and other minor/patch updates: automerge when all required checks pass.

Pin updates keep the version already in use and carry no release timestamp; under the default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour (timestamp-required) renovate/stability-days would stay pending forever. Real version bumps keep the 3-day wait.
